A slender claymore thought to have been handed down to the kingdom of Hyrule ages ago. The blade shines with a holy luster.|Inventory|TotK}} also known as the {{Term/Store|Sword of the Six Sages|Swords of the Six Sages|BotW}},{{Exp Game|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Sword of the Six Sages}}
The Six Sages are said to have forged this longsword to seal a demon king in the world where the hero fought against the beasts of twilight. The blade shines with a holy luster.|Inventory|BotW}} is a recurring [[Item]] and [[Object]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. The Dusk Claymore goes unnamed in {{TP}}, {{SSBB}}, and {{SSB4}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{TP|-}}=== Prior to the events of {{TP|-}}, the six [[Sage]]s forged the Dusk Claymore to execute the Demon King, [[Ganondorf]]. When this execution took place, the six Sages gathered at the [[Mirror Chamber]] with Ganondorf in chains. The [[Sage of Water]] thrust the Dusk Claymore into Ganondorf's chest.{{Fact|TPHD}} However, the attempt was in vain, as the [[Triforce of Power]] kept him alive. Ganondorf withdrew the Sword from his body and broke free from his chains to kill the Sage of Water. Despite failing to kill him, it did inflict a glowing wound on Ganondorf that never healed. The wound later acts as [[Dark Beast Ganon]] and Ganondorf's weak point. During the final sword battle between [[Link]] and Ganondorf, Link plunges the [[Master Sword]] into the wound, defeating him. Even though the Sages banish Ganondorf to the [[Twilight Realm]], he manages to keep the Dusk Claymore and use it against Link in the final battle. Ganondorf wishes to blot out the light forever with this blade.{{Cite|Would you hear my desire? To take this foul blade...and use it to blot out the light forever!|Ganondorf|TP}} Link never wields the Dusk Claymore in {{TP|-}}. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 48 |durability = 50 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} The Sword of the Six Sages appears in {{BotW}} as an exclusive [[amiibo]] [[Item]]. It has a rare chance of appearing in a [[Treasure Chest]] after scanning the {{SSB|-}} Series [[Ganondorf]] amiibo with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], although only after Link has tamed at least one of the [[Divine Beast]]s. The Sword of the Six Sages functions as a two-handed [[Weapon]], and its description refers to it as a longsword. Additionally, its sheath is the same one used by Ganondorf in {{TP|-}}. It shines with a holy luster that causes it to glow in dark areas such as the [[Thyphlo Ruins]]. Link can acquire replacements via using the Ganondorf amiibo if it breaks or if it is lost. Being made of metal, the Sword of the Six Sages will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if it is equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. It will also sink if dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but it can be picked back up and manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. If it is exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], it will not burn as wooden [[Weapon]]s do. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_057" |Life = 50 |Power = 48 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 10 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 8 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 25 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 11 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 19 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 26 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 43 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 8 |BuyingPrice = 30 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK}} {{Stub|TotK}} In contrast to {{BotW|-}}, the Dusk Claymore's damage has been reduced to 32 and its [[Durability]] has been reduced to 50. It can be obtained as a reward for completing all four stages of the "[[Investigate the Thyphlo Ruins]]" [[Side Quest]]. It can also be found from scanning the {{SSB|-}} series [[Ganondorf]] [[amiibo]]. Once it has been obtained, it can be purchased from any [[Bargainer Statue]] for 140 [[Poe]]s. ==Other Appearances== ==={{SSBB|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{SSBB}}, Ganondorf shows the Sword during one of his taunts. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSB4|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{SSB4}}, Ganondorf shows the Sword as a taunt. He can also attack with it by using the Warlock Blade, a custom neutral special move that replaces the Warlock Punch. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== *While Ganondorf is wielding the sword in {{TP|-}}, the color changes from white to a glowing red; while this may be just due to the lighting, its similar coloration in {{SSB|-}} could mean the color change is intentional. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:TP Ganondorf Render.png|{{Game Label|{{TP|-}}}}Ganondorf with the Sword of the Six Sages File:TP Ganondorf's Sword Concept Art.jpg|{{Game Label|{{TP|-}}}}Concept art of the Sword of the Six Sages File:BotW Link with Sword of Six Sages Model.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Link wielding the Sword of the Six Sages File:Ganondorf Taunt.jpg|{{Game Label|{{SSBB|-}}}}Ganondorf with the Sword of the Six Sages File:SSB4 Ganon Warlock Blade.jpg|{{Game Label|{{SSBfN3DS|-}}}}Ganondorf performing the Warlock Blade {{Ref}} {{Categories |Claymores, Swords |items= TotK |objects= TP, TPHD, SSBB, SSBfN3DS, SSBfWU }}
